name: ArcherMind Technology Co., Ltd.
summary: ArcherMind Technology Co., Ltd. engages in the research, development, and sale of software technology services and solutions in China and internationally. The company offers intelligent terminal solutions for smartphone, tablet, industry terminal, and VR; intelligent car solutions, such as toolchain, support, and autonomous driving SW platform, as well as smart cockpit and central control domain software platforms; and IoT solutions, including smart city, healthcare, home, and kitchen and bath. It also provides a GoFintech mobile financial platform; machine vision solutions; and interactive design, software research and development, and software testing services.
